items.title: Compact Unread Badges
items.subtitle: Swap the unread count for a dot, or tint badges with your theme's color, in Interface settings.

items.title: Themed Tabs and Buttons
items.subtitle: Tint unselected tab icons and Liquid Glass buttons with your theme's accent in Theme Manager.

items.title: Subscriptions Stay Put
items.subtitle: A failed background refresh no longer empties your subreddit list.
